name: Bal Gangadhar Tilak
contribution: An Indian nationalist and self-rule activist in the Indian independence movement.
legacy: This person was one of the first and strongest advocates of Swaraj and is known for his quote in Marathi: "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it!"

checks.lead: Bal Gangadhar Tilak (born Keshav Gangadhar Tilak (pronunciation: [keʃəʋ ɡəŋɡaːd̪ʱəɾ ʈiɭək]); 23 July 1856 – 1 August 1920), was an Indian nationalist and self-rule activist in the Indian independence movement. He was one third of the Lal Bal Pal triumvirate. The honorific "Lokmanya" (meaning "accepted by the people as their leader") was applied to him by his supporters.
